key_idea: Turning a card does not change the shape on it, only which way it points.
steps: The card on the right shows 3 squares in an L shape, in the bottom left of the card.
Card B also has 3 squares in an L shape, in the top left corner.
Turn card B a quarter turn to the left. Its L moves to the bottom left and looks just like the card on the right.

choice_feedback.A: A has 3 squares in a straight line, with no corner.
choice_feedback.C: C has 4 squares, but the card on the right has 3.
choice_feedback.D: D has 4 squares in a big square, but the card on the right has 3.
choice_feedback.E: The squares on E only touch at their corners, not along their sides.
